 Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind
 issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents 1 to 4 to 
 appropriate action against the unauthorised construction put up by 
 and 6th respondents of the commercial food court building running i
 name of Ellery Food Zone, consisting of 29 shops measuring to an
 extent of 7000 sq.ft. approximately situated at Nallambakkam Villag
 Vandalur Taluk, Chengalpattu District, comprised in Sruvey Nos.3/A2
 3/A2C, 3/A2C2 abd 3/A2B measuring to an extent of 71 cents and to
 demolish the same.

 ORDER (Order of the Court was made by the Hon'ble Chief Justice)

Learned Additional Advocate General,
Sri.Ravindran, tenders four photographs, all taken on 22.04.2025 and relying on those photographs,
submits that all constructions in the illegal food zone have been removed.
The photographs are taken on record and marked as 'X' collectively.

2. Learned Additional Advocate General also assures the Court that such illegality shall not be permitted henceforth and the authorities will be https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
09/06/2025 02:26:41 pm ) prompt in taking action.
3. Counsel for petitioner also confirms that the unauthorised commercial food court running in the name of Ellery Food Zone consisting of 29 shops situated at Nallambakkam Village, Vandalur Taluk,
Chengalpattu District, has been removed.
4.
The other counsels appearing for respondent Nos.8 to 10 also assure the Court that no illegality will be permitted.
The statements of all the three counsels made on behalf of respondents 8 to 10 are accepted as undertaking to the Court.
In view of the above, petition stands disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.

Consequently,
the interim application stands closed.
(K.R.SHRIRAM, CJ.)
